derivation.formula: threshold = mean(reference overall) - pooled_std(reference overall, candidate overall); pooled_std = sqrt(((n_ref - 1) * var_ref + (n_cand - 1) * var_cand) / (n_ref + n_cand - 2)) with sample variances; result clamped to [1, 5] and rounded to 3 decimals
